oliver: Quick question — docs-only PRs are stacking and blocking small fixes. Can we define a merge cadence or a fast-track signal so tiny doc fixes don't wait 48+ hours?
maya: yep, noticed this too. main blocker is flaky docs preview CI — sometimes it times out even when the change is trivial.
kevin: what if we had a lightweight label like `docs-fast-track` + a small rule: docs-only + lint + linkcheck pass => eligible for same-day merge. keep it manual for now (rotating reviewer) then automate if it behaves.
sam: curious how we detect "docs-only" reliably. filename globs? PR files list? also need to avoid bypassing if there's code-ish changes in examples.
oliver: detection via GitHub: check that changed paths are under `docs/` or `site/` and no `src/` or `examples/` diffs. basic script exists in other repos we can adapt.
maya: note: preview infra occasionally returns 500 when building large previews — that was why #1234 failed yesterday. @docs-ci-bot can you paste the build link and relevant log snippet?
docs-ci-bot: Preview build for PR #1234 — FAILED
  · URL: https://preview.redwood-inference.test/builds/1234
  · Error: timeout pulling docker image for preview runtime (attempt 3/3)
  · Logs: "ERROR: timed out fetching base image"
kevin: thanks. so rule should include a condition: if preview build fails with infra timeout -> retry once; if still fails, put PR into a daily "docs retry" queue instead of full reviewer handoff.
sam: operationally we can do a weekly rotation for the human reviewer. propose: one reviewer is on-call for docs-fast-track each week, they can merge docs-only PRs meeting the checklist. who volunteers for this week?
maya: I can take this week.
oliver: awesome. Kevin, can you sketch the checklist to add to the PR template? short bullet list pls.
kevin: sure — add to `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`:
```
- docs-only: [ ] (changes only under `docs/` or `site/`)
- linkcheck: [ ] (CI linkcheck passed)
- lint: [ ] (Spellcheck/lint passed)
- preview: [ ] (preview succeeded or failed with infra timeout and retried)
- reviewer-fasttrack: @<team-member> (weekly rotator)
```
maya: also add: "if examples code changed, request a code review" — keep the fast-track strictly for non-executable content.
sam: agree. I'll create a short RFC PR to document the flow and add the label + reviewer team. trial period: 2 weeks. if CI flakiness > 10% we pause automation.
oliver: sounds good. action items: sam -> RFC + label + assign rotation; kevin -> PR template update; maya -> this week's fast-track reviewer; docs-ci-bot -> add a one-time retry for preview infra failures (ops ticket if needed).
kevin: noted, I'll open the PR for the template in next 2 hours.
maya: I'll watch the queue and merge small fixes today. :thumbsup:
oliver: thanks all — let's check back at the end of the trial. :calendar:
__note: This thread is a single continuous Slack conversation string. Messages are brief and in chronological order per agents.md rules.
